correctness.rationale: Subcubic representative pair lemma gives an upper bound by singleton set T and matched edges M. Statuses U,T,L,R,V on a two-row column yield 17 allowed column types; column weight counts colors once, and a weight-2 column forces weight-zero successor, proving maximum n for C_n□K_2 (n≥3). Closed local pair states with matching and singleton constraints form 119 transfer states and 343 transitions, giving a bijection to reduced optimal colorings with labelled vertices but unlabelled colors. Independently reconstructed the full integer transfer matrix: traces for n=3..12 are 16,65,151,434,1177,3225,8890,24337,66947,183638 and characteristic polynomial is x^103(x^2-1)^2 (x^5+x^4-x^3+x-1)(x^7-2x^6-3x^5+2x^4+2x^3-2x-1). The trace-log-determinant identity proves the rational generating function for all n, not by fitting finite data.

The mere maximum n is not treated as independent novelty. Similar circular-ladder topology and prism domination enumerations concern different invariants.
